contexts.text: The celestial Angels merely say that it is so, or is not so. Signified. AC 1384. AC 9818, Explained. AE 826:2.
The case stands thus. AC 2116, etc.
The infants only said it is not so.

The spiritual argue whether it is so; but the celestial know and perceive that it is so; hence the Lord says Let your discourse be Yea, yea... (). AC 2718:2. AC 2718:4. AC 2718:5. AC 3246:2. AC 9166:2.
He wanted to reason whether it is so.
Causes perception that it is so, or is not so.
Persuaded by others that it is so.
When they want to know anything, they say that it is so... for when it is not so, a resistance is perceived.
This Intellectual... is an apperception that it is so.
Thus = what is to be done.
Celestial Angels only say, Yea, or Nay. AC 10124:2. AC 10786.
The celestial Angels never debate whether it is so, or is not so.
He sees in himself that it is so as soon as he hears it.
The Spirits of Mercury said, This is so; this is not so.
When they hear those of the Spiritual Kingdom, they say, when they speak truths, It is so; but when they do not speak truths, they say that it is so; that it should be said so.
